meals: Beef and corn burritos with cheese and salsa verde
green curry with spinach and basa fillets
weeks.notes: Went with burritos because pantry only had a few ingredients at the time, and they only needed to be seasoned with taco seasoning. Went with eggs with oatmeal and quesadillas because these are both very quick to prepare.
weeks.feedback: Spinach came out with a poor texture in the curry, burritos were fine, I enjoyed the simplicity of the quesadillas and eggs with oatmeal -- this is a good benchmark for the level of difficulty I want for the quick meals each week. Note that I can handle more complexity on the meal prep meals.
